notes.title: Filament Bug Fixes & Updates - 24th April 2020
notes.notes:
First of all:

Thank you to those who told us about these game bugs & reported them to us on both here on Steam community & on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/filamentpuzzle]Discord. [/url]

You make our cosmic game that much better by doing so, so thank you!  

So here's our Filament Hotfix for 24/04/2020:

- Fixed the rare bug that yeets player into space.
- Fixed the cable that wasn't lighting up in requisite 8.
- Fixed the options menu not correctly detecting resolution.
- Fixed the terminal not unlocking when tabbing out as terminal launches.
- Fixed the terminal transparency sorting issue.
- Fixed the log numbers displaying wrong in different languages.
- Fixed the issue with Opus 3 anchor not begin accessible after using ladder.
- Fixed the issue getting stuck behind anchor in medbay.
- Fixed the collision on requisite 5.
- Archways now make a noise when you pass through them.
- Fixed the visual issues in living room.
- Fixed the visual issues in kitchen.
- Fixed the archways not closing an already open door when you overload them.
- Fixed the wrapping pillars not closing an already open door when you overload them.
- Fixed formatting issues in messages when viewing in Japanese.

Speak to you soon, Operatives!

notes.title: Attention: Marmalade Edition Update
notes.notes:
Attention all Operatives! 

We must announce that due to a minor setback:

[h3]Our game's soundtrack, part of the Marmalade Edition, will not be readily available to listen to upon purchasing at 3pm BST. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/00bea910bf2e90859ac0572cd0aaead2da3a3fd1.png[/img]

[b]You will still be able to purchase the Marmalade Edition as normal[/b] & will still get access to the amazing Marmalade's Sketchbook immediately & the soundtrack will still appear in your library, however, the music tracks themselves will be slightly delayed until the technical issue is resolved.

[h3]Once the issue is resolved, the soundtrack will activate immediately & you can listen to our sci-fi sounds to your heart's content![/h3]

Please know we are working on fixing this as quickly as possible & will notify you once the problem has been resolved. Apologies for any inconvenience caused.
